text:
Gabe: Heads-up: the Golden Stapler is missing from the supply closet. Last seen near the printer shrine. Who's on stakeout?
Marta: Not it, but if the stapler is gone we should start the "Staple Quest" tradition. A map and riddles.
Lin: Wait, Golden Stapler? Is that the one with the tiny star sticker? I thought Felix had custody last week.
Omar: I borrowed it to secure a very important deck and left it on top of my monitor. If it's missing now I'm sending a search party.
closet-bot: Reminder: supply closet access logged at 08:12 and 12:47. No stapler check-outs recorded in the last 24h.
Felix: Guilty of stewardship but innocent of theft. I placed the star sticker for morale.
Nora: Proposal: if we can't find it, create a trial and appoint a Staple Knight. Duties: oversee office staples and resolve clip disputes.
Gabe: Poll time: 1) Search party (led by Gabe) 2) Appoint Staple Knight 3) Create a new Golden Stapler (DIY). React with 1/2/3.
Marta: Also adding lore note: the "Staple of Ages" must be handled with oven mitts. (joke)
Lin: Vote 1. I will help search the printer shrine and under the couch cushions.
Felix: Vote 3. I've got spray-gold paint and a spare stapler. DIY is tempting.
Omar: Vote 2. Staple Knight sounds delightful. Nominate Gabe? He already created the quest.
closet-bot: Poll created: 1) Search party 2) Appoint Staple Knight 3) DIY Golden Stapler. Voting open for 6h.
Nora: Also, if we make a new one, can it have interchangeable capes? For holidays.
Gabe: If we do a DIY, can the internals be flame-retardant? Safety first.
closet-bot: Poll closed. Results: Search party 3, Appoint Staple Knight 2, DIY 2.
Gabe: Search party wins. Meet at printer shrine in 5. Bring flashlights and snacks.
Marta: I'll bring sticky notes and a tiny lantern. This is now officially an office adventure.
Felix: If we fail, I will paint a replacement and do a consecration ceremony.
Omar: Update after search: found it... in the potted plant. Someone thought it looked lonely and made it a planter guardian. Mystery solved.
Nora: Adding to lore: "The Stapler That Became One With the Ficus" recorded. Also awarding Gabe honorary title 'Quest Initiator'.
Gabe: Closing thread. Thank you to the retrieval team. Reminder: don't feed office supplies to plants. :seedling:
